newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle very slow - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle very slow - USDA.

text.p: Trade very slow. Not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for a market test.
Inquiry good, demand fair. Sales confirmed on 100 slaughter steers and 200 slaughter heifers Wednesday.
For the week to date 35,200 head confirmed including 15,300 head or 43 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter steers Few Select and Choice 2-3 1275 lb Holsteins 57.00.
Slaughter heifers Few Select and Choice 1100 lbs 63.00.
